name: STiXR
summary: Education VR brings learning to life through immersive virtual reality experiences. Explore science, history, and technology inside fully interactive 3D worlds — conduct virtual lab experiments, examine detailed models, travel to historical sites, and understand complex concepts through hands-on simulations. Designed for students and teachers, the app makes learning engaging, visual, and memorable.
